Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in historical reasoning and source interpretation. In Step 10, the Planner incorrectly concluded that Maria of Aragon (Queen of Portugal) was "Portuguese" based on her title and the language labels on the Wikipedia page. This contradicts the explicit information found in the same source (Step 9), which states she was the daughter of Isabella I of Castile and Ferdinand II of Aragon. The Planner failed to recognize that "Queen of Portugal" denotes her role as a consort, not her nationality of birth. The correct nationality, supported by her parentage (Castile and Aragon, both Spanish kingdoms), is Spanish. The Planner prematurely declared the task complete with a factually incorrect answer ("Portuguese") instead of synthesizing the parentage data to correctly infer "Spanish" or "Aragonese/Castilian."
